blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senators have urged government agencies to step up preparations for the possible impacts of “Super El Niño.” “Government agencies should step up information drive, proper information dissemination so that people are prepared and know what the government’s steps are ahead of the El Niño,” said Sen. Francis Pangilinan in an interview with radio DWIZ He also emphasized the government’s readiness to protect the agriculture sector and ensure the country’s food supply ahead of El Niño, which is forecast to worsen and persist until early next year.
